purpose: Screen-coordinate visual audit; not a promise of source-perfect hidden-pixel recovery.
coordinate_convention: Top-left origin; bounds [x,y,width,height], half-open. No alignment or camera compensation.
method: Direct view_image inspection of both full-size images.
Cell coordinates provide deterministic comparison, not semantic tile boundaries.
Observed means visible in reference; all hidden reconstruction is explicitly inferred.
Source visible-region masks may guide cutouts but do not contain hidden surfaces.
Three visible waterfall outlets: upper left, upper right, lower right. Three horizontal floor grates plus one tall wall inset.
status: audit-authored; acceptance unchecked; no reconstruction validation claimed
